overview.text: Punjab & Sind Bank, Zonal Office Bhopal invites sealed E-Tender proposals for Interior Furnishing, Electrical, Data Cabling, and Air Conditioning works at its new Model Branch in Tilhari Jabalpur. The tender requires bidders to submit a Bid Securing Declaration and adhere to the Bank's Integrity Pact policy.

issuing_organization: Punjab & Sind Bank, Zonal Office Bhopal

scope.text: The scope includes Interior Furnishing, Electrical, Data Cabling, and Air Conditioning works for the PSB TILHARI JABALPUR Branch.
Contractors must furnish wooden partitioning, paneling, false ceilings, and miscellaneous items, ensuring complete provision to the satisfaction of Architects and the Bank.
Work execution must strictly follow drawings amplified by specifications of materials and workmanship, with contractors supplying all material implements at their own cost.

The contractor is responsible for true setting out based on original points, employing sufficient labour (no persons under fifteen), and submitting samples of materials for approval prior to execution.
The contractor must remove all scaffolding, surplus materials, rubbish, and clean dirt from the building before being furnished with a certificate of completion.

key_requirements.text: Bidders must create a login ID & password on the website (https://psb.eproc.in) for registration and submit bids in English only.
Earnest money of Rs. 56,000/- must be deposited as a Demand Draft; MSE/MSME bidders are exempted from this deposit.
The Technical Bid must include the Service Provider's Profile, Profit and Loss Account, Balance sheet, List of contracts, and performance certificates.
Bidders must possess valid CMMI Level-3 or Level-5 certification and provide minimum five (5) satisfactory performance certificates.

eligibility.text: Bidders must be eligible to do business in India under relevant Indian Laws and possess licenses for employing labour.
The bidder must have executed minimum one similar work in M.P./C.G. with a value of Rs. 22.32 Lakhs, or two works of Rs. 16.74 Lakhs, or three works of Rs. 13.95 Lakhs.
Bidders must provide minimum five (5) satisfactory performance certificates, with at least one for each year.

important_dates.text: Bids shall be valid for a period of 03 months from the date of submission of bids.
Successful bidder shall enter into contract within 15 days of award.
The NDA shall be executed by the authorized signatory within one month from the date of acceptance of letter of empanelment or signing of work order/SLA.

commercial_requirements.text: The Price quoted should be only in Indian Rupees and inclusive of all labour charges, delivery & cost of material at site tools & equipment, insurance premium covering any risk to labour etc. and taxes.
No claim for rate enhancement/price revision should be considered during the pendency of the contract.
Earnest money deposit of Rs. 56,000.00/- (EMD) should be deposited; MSE/MSME bidders are exempted from payment of Earnest Money Deposit.

project_duration.text: Mobilization Period: 7 days from the date of Work Order.
Completion Period: 30 days from date of commencement.
['Time is the essence of the contract']
['The owner and contractor shall agree upon work progress chart indicating forecast dates; it may be amended by agreement within limitations imposed in the contract']

important_conditions.text: The tender shall be covered under the Integrity Pact (IP) policy of the Bank. Any vendor/bidder not signed the document or refusing to sign shall be disqualified in the bidding process.
No compensation shall be payable to the contractor on whatever account for suspension of work.
The contractor shall indemnify the Bank against any claim for any person arising from injury due to neglect of safety precautions or fencing.
The contractor shall be solely responsible for monthly payment of wages and ESI/EPF; failure may result in expenses being deducted from security deposit.
